Bar chart shows the proportion of protein population bound to a given number of metal atoms, derived from relative peak intensities in a single native MS spectrum. This is a single quantified proportion rather than a mean computed across replicate measurements (no error bars are shown), so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
Same type of single-spectrum-derived proportion bar chart as panel C; no averaging across replicates is indicated (no error bars), so individual data points are not applicable.
